readout_other: Electromyography (EMG) from the left forelimb; video recording of forelimb shaking/motion responses
direction_notes: Ultrasonic stimulation of target A (a site selected as sensitive to ultrasound) reliably elicited forelimb shaking and much higher EMG amplitude than stimulation of target B (a reference site 3 mm away), which produced no visible movement.

exposures.label: Target A: brain site selected as a sensitive ultrasound-responsive circuit (forelimb shaking response)

target.label: Target A, described only by stereotaxic coordinates (~4 mm anteroposterior from bregma, 3.5 mm lateral from midline), chosen in 'a relatively sensitive brain circuit responding to the ultrasound stimulus'; Target B (a non-exposure active control site) was located about 3 mm lateral to Target A

timing.protocol_description: The pulse generator excited the dual-mode transducer with long pulses (about 13 ms) in the neuromodulation mode, versus short pulses (0.2 microseconds) in the imaging mode. The acoustic pressure (P0) was about 930 kPa, the pulse duration (T1) was 13 ms, and the stimulus interval (T2) between successive stimuli was 3 s. Stimulation was applied alternately to targets A and B.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Three male C57BL/6 mice aged 10–12 weeks and weighing $2 1 \pm 5 \% \textrm { g }$ (mean standard deviation) were used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A 128 channel linear array-based ultrasound system with 5-MHz center frequency is proposed for imageguided neuromodulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The acoustic pressure $( P _ { 0 } )$ was about 930 kPa, the pulse duration $( T _ { 1 } )$ was 13 ms, and the stimulus interval (T<sub>2</sub>) was 3 s.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: The spatial peak temporal average intensity $( I _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } )$ was about 123 mW/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The acoustic pressure $( P _ { 0 } )$ was about 930 kPa, the pulse duration $( T _ { 1 } )$ was 13 ms, and the stimulus interval (T<sub>2</sub>) was 3 s.

flags.reason: Paper gives only stereotaxic coordinates and a functional description ('a relatively sensitive brain circuit') for Target A, with no named anatomical structure, so target.terms is 'other'.
Domain (free field vs in situ/through skull) is not stated for the 930 kPa pressure and 123 mW/cm2 Ispta values used for in vivo mouse brain stimulation.

Classified as 'continuous' because the paper describes a single uninterrupted 13 ms pulse (T1) repeated every 3 s (T2, stimulus interval), with no internal pulse-repetition structure described within the 13 ms burst; however this interpretation could not be independently corroborated with additional waveform detail.
